elements.title: Matrículas pagas
elements.commandsql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mdl_local_kopere_pay_enrollment WHERE status='paid'

elements.title: Cursos Pagos
elements.commandsql:
SELECT c.fullname,
         count(*)
    FROM mdl_local_kopere_pay_enrollment pm
    JOIN mdl_course c ON pm.course = c.id
   WHERE pm.status = 'paid'
GROUP BY c.fullname

elements.title: Cursos não pagos
elements.commandsql:
SELECT c.fullname,
         count(*)
    FROM mdl_local_kopere_pay_enrollment pm
    JOIN mdl_course c ON pm.course = c.id
   WHERE pm.status != 'paid'
GROUP BY c.id

elements.title: Cupons por Curso
elements.commandsql:
SELECT c.fullname AS "Curso",
       COUNT(m.coupon) AS "Cupons"
FROM mdl_local_kopere_pay_enrollment m
JOIN mdl_course c ON m.course = c.id
GROUP BY c.id

elements.title: Pagamentos por Curso
elements.commandsql:
SELECT c.fullname AS "Curso",
       COUNT(m.id) AS "Total de estudantes",
       COUNT(CASE WHEN m.status = 'paid' THEN 1 END) AS "Pagos",
       COUNT(CASE WHEN m.status != 'paid' THEN 1 END) AS "Não pagos"
FROM mdl_local_kopere_pay_enrollment m
JOIN mdl_course c ON m.course = c.id
GROUP BY c.fullname

elements.title: Status de Pagamento por Data
elements.commandsql:
SELECT
    FROM_UNIXTIME(pm.lasttime, '%Y-%m') AS "Data",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN pm.status = 'paid' THEN 1 END) AS "Pago",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN pm.status = 'waiting' THEN 1 END) AS "Aguardando pagamento"
FROM mdl_local_kopere_pay_enrollment pm
GROUP BY pm.lasttime
ORDER BY pm.lasttime
